purpose: Create a non-production, label-free C1 shadow artifact and pre-register the only fair future comparison between the two formal development candidates. This protocol does not authorize a production change.

target.definition: same-origin valid-stock four-week raw return minus the same-origin cross-sectional median, classified at fixed -1%/+1% thresholds

excluded_candidates.REV8_C2_CUDA_FIXED_RG2_RG3_XGBOOST: development worst-fold hard gate failed; it is not eligible for future selection
excluded_candidates.REV8_C3_FIXED_HALF_CUDA_HALF_INCUMBENT_B: post-result exploration; it is not eligible for formal selection

c1_full_refit.allowed_inputs: development assets above only; no FRESH, SCREENING, FINAL, sealed holdout, or future target payload
c1_full_refit.fit_population: all unique development trade_date/stock_code rows with target_valid=true
c1_full_refit.location_features: the exact 14 RG3 plus 18 RG2 order from the frozen C1 protocol
c1_full_refit.model: heteroscedastic proportional odds; location_l2=0.001; scale_l2=0.01; LBFGS double precision max_iter=200
c1_full_refit.calibration: three expanding TRAIN-only-style chronological OOF splits over the full development panel; 11-week embargo; 26-week minimum fit; exact frozen temperature/prior grid; choose maximum MCC subject to Brier <= grid minimum + 0.005; ties use lower temperature then lower shrinkage

future_evaluation.origin_rule: each origin strictly later than 2026-06-26, with completed four-week outcomes; keys must be from a frozen point-in-time universe
required_before_prediction: future RG3 coverage and source_trade_date PIT audit
future RG2 18-feature coverage and PIT-date audit for C1
candidate and incumbent prediction input SHA manifests
new one-time label authorization naming exactly these two candidates and the incumbent
order: generate and seal C0, C1, and incumbent predictions without labels
report MCC, Brier, ECE, weekly IC, IC confidence interval, and paper-cost metrics
single-machine shadow/paper before any promotion review
future_evaluation.selection: A candidate must independently meet all pre-registered gates. If both pass, select the one with higher mean weekly IC only if its 95% moving-block IC confidence interval lower bound is positive and it has no worse MCC, Brier, or paper-cost gate outcome; otherwise retain incumbent and do not break a tie post hoc.
future_evaluation.no_compensation: No average improvement can offset a worst-window, calibration, PIT, coverage, or paper-cost failure.

resources.c1_full_refit: CPU only; torch intra-op threads=2 and inter-op threads=1
resources.future_prediction: C0/C1 CPU sequentially; no concurrent GPU workload

forbidden: adding C2 or C3 to the formal family
